sentence_stem: Had she known about the delay,
correct_completion: she would have taken an earlier train.
full_sentence: Had she known about the delay, she would have taken an earlier train.
acceptable_variants: she would have caught an earlier train.
she would have left the house sooner.

options.text: she takes an earlier train every day.
options.why_wrong: The present simple describes a habit, but the stem requires an unreal past condition introduced by 'had'.

options.text: she is going to take an earlier train tomorrow.
options.why_wrong: This talks about a future plan, which does not complete a hypothetical past condition.

options.text: she would have taken an earlier train.
she will take the earlier train if possible.
options.why_wrong: This uses a real future condition, which does not match the unreal past meaning set up by 'had known'.

grammar_focus: Third conditional with inversion ('Had + subject + past participle')
explanation: In an inverted third conditional, 'had' comes before the subject instead of 'if'. The main clause then uses 'would have' plus a past participle to describe what did not happen.
